title: Store the result first
prompt: Write `area`, which returns width times height. In `two_rooms`, store area(width, height) in a variable, then return twice that, for two identical rooms. two_rooms(3, 4) is 24.
hints: Catch the returned value in a variable, then use the variable in the return line.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
